issue_context.title: Build ends with error if inlined web worker is used
issue_context.body:
## Describe the bug

Build ends with error if [inlined workers](https://github.com/vitejs/vite#inline-web-workers) are used.
`indexHtmlPath` in [build/index.ts](https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/2055b0c21c5fd7f9e69dc38e19ae092a6656962e/src/node/build/index.ts#L585) concatenates `outDir` twice because of `createEmitPlugin` handler double call.

With static worker file from `/public` directory build finishes successfully.

## Reproduction

https://github.com/taigabrew/vite-build-bug-a4da7c3e

## System Info

- `vite` version: 1.0.0-rc.9
- Operating System: macOS Catalina 10.15.7
- Node version: v14.14.0
- yarn version: 1.22.4
- Installed `vue` version: 3.0.2
- Installed `@vue/compiler-sfc` version: 3.0.2

## Logs (Optional if provided reproduction)

```
warning package.json: No license field
$ /Users/taiga/Proj/sandbox/vite_123/node_modules/.bin/vite build --debug
vite v1.0.0-rc.9
  vite:config env mode: production +0ms
  vite:config env: {} +1ms
Building production bundle...
  vite:build:resolve /src/main.js --> /Users/taiga/Proj/sandbox/vite_123/src/main.js +0ms
[vite] Build errored out.
[Error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open '/Users/taiga/Proj/sandbox/vite_123/dist/Users/taiga/Proj/sandbox/vite_123/dist/index.html'] {
  errno: -2,
  code: 'PLUGIN_ERROR',
  syscall: 'open',
  path: '/Users/taiga/Proj/sandbox/vite_123/dist/Users/taiga/Proj/sandbox/vite_123/dist/index.html',
  pluginCode: 'ENOENT',
  plugin: 'vite:emit',
  hook: 'generateBundle'
}
error Command failed with exit code 1.
```

review_comments: `rollup-plugin-worker-loader` generates a bundle using the same options of the bundle it was plugged into, which results in `vite:emit` being used by it. Since the worker bundle is generated and not written, we can safely bail out here when the output name is different. This avoids clearing the `outDir` too many times and passing the wrong assets to `renderIndex`.
